claim: The demo turns a selected sample region into editable text.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; activate the shipped inventory region and assert useful rows appear

claim: Screen images stay on your computer.
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; intercept the full capture and pin flow and assert no cross-origin requests

claim: Recognised text can be spoken with the device voice.
where: landing workflow and demo Speak text button
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo with a speech synthesis spy; assert the recognised text reaches the device speech API

claim: Recognised text can be pinned and removed.
where: landing workflow and demo Pin result button
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; pin the sample result, assert its contents, then remove it

claim: Demo sample data is not saved.
where: first action and persistent demo banner
sandbox: fresh browser context at /demo; use and reset the demo, then assert no demo storage keys and no visible result

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo, wait for the service worker, set the context offline, reload, and assert the demo heading

claim: English OCR files ship with the app.
sandbox: fresh browser context; fetch the same-origin English language model and OCR worker and assert both contain data

claim: A valid supporter license activates two blueprint page themes.
sandbox: fresh browser context with a recorded valid license response; select the second theme and assert its palette is applied
